name: Dear..
source:
Main character has wet dreams about his childhood friend. But she also pays him much attention at school, then visits his room, and the dream comes true.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-december-2000-never7-end-of.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公夜夜都在做着与青梅竹马缠绵的春梦。而白天的校园里她也对他格外关注，随后更主动来到他的房间做客，让那场春梦化为了现实。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-december-2000-never7-end-of.html]vndbreview[/url]]
